body:
ADVISOR: operator decision 21:09, recorded as ADR-76 (read it: aida show ADR-76). Add it to every reviewer prompt you launch from now on.

STRICT tier: ADR-75 sensitive areas, plus gate/guard code (merge-hold, verdicts, pr-ship gates, refusing hooks, watchdog, night-shift guards, lease safety). Unchanged: every finding blocks.

STANDARD tier: everything else. ONLY these block: a demonstrated correctness defect, fail-open or data loss, a state-corrupting race, an incomplete fix (acceptance not met), contract drift, red CI or a flaky test added to the default suite. Surviving mutations or untested paths in non-gate code where the behaviour is correct, style, naming and doc staleness do NOT block. File them as ONE review-follow-up task per PR (approved, mode drain) and APPROVE.

Re-assess under ADR-76 any open STANDARD-tier REQUEST CHANGES whose only blockers are now non-blocking: #2600 (TASK-1740, forge tests) and #2598 (BUG-1962) are candidates. If they qualify, record a fresh APPROVE at the same head through a fresh reviewer and merge. FIX-FORWARD still applies to small real blockers.
subject: ADR-76: tiered review bar, effective now (applies to reviews in flight)
